Yesterday I was bearish on Nasdaq.

My system went long anyway.
That is exactly why I trust systems more than opinions.

Discretionary me would probably have skipped the trade.
My bot did not care.
It followed the rules, bought the intraday volatility breakout, and the trade finished as a solid winner.

That is an important lesson in systematic trading:

Your market opinion and your execution process should not be the same thing.

The core logic is simple:

- calculate volatility bands from the open
- trade only on days when emotion and expansion are likely
- enter in the direction of the first breakout
- take a small loss if it fails, or exit at EOD

This is not about prediction.
It is about risk management, consistency, and being in the market when the expansion finally comes.

I have traded this OOS since 05/2023.
On the screen is the continuous backtest - fees included, no compounding.
